## Worst payment processor i've dealt with
I'm a new customer, this company was chosen for me by a solar installer as a packaged HELOC.  
My single biggest complaint so far, aside from what I regard as questionable loan practices is their payment processing track record.  
They are by a huge margin the slowest processors of payments of anyone I have dealt with in years. Considering Mosaic is owned by Paypal (I looked it up), I can't fathom why it would take them as much as almost a month to process a physical payment that arrives by mail direct from my bank. If I go through their portal to pay online, it still may take a week or so for them to process it.  
Regarding loan practices: [...] ## One of the Worst Experiences
One of the Worst Experiences – Avoid Mosaic at All Costs  
  
I was in escrow to sell my home, and because of Mosaic, the sale completely fell through. No matter what the potential buyer did submitting documents for husband and wife ran credits (they were approved for $700k home loan but not for a $65k solar loan), following up repeatedly Mosaic refused to approve the solar loan. Their communication was terrible, their process was slow and unclear, and their customer service was completely unhelpful.  
  
Their failure to act in a timely or reasonable manner caused me to lose a qualified buyer and ultimately my home sale. This company directly caused the collapse of my escrow and a huge amount of stress and financial loss. [...] If you partner with Mosaic for solar financing:  
  
Your customers may end up with unmarketable homes they can’t sell unless they pay off a loan they were told was transferable.  
  
You could be exposing your clients to financial and legal harm down the road, which could reflect poorly on your brand.  
  
🚨 This company is not trustworthy, and they’ve put their borrowers in impossible positions while hiding behind bankruptcy protection.  
If you’ve been harmed by Mosaic:  
  
File a complaint with the CFPB and California DFPI  
  
This is not a one-off case. If you’re a seller, installer, or buyer — steer clear of Mosaic Solar Financing.
